claims: One prompt yields a handful of completely different designs
Version 4.0 ('Worlds') ships 100+ design systems, all rated by a human
Claude's own design idea competes against the library and the winning direction is built
Impeccable Live gets you out of the terminal to preview and click around each variant, then pick one
how_to_steps: Run it on a site prompt; it proposes several 'worlds' (e.g. Minishomp Room, The Darkroom, Phosphor Terminal, Cloud Quarry) plus Claude's own idea
Open Impeccable Live in the browser (localhost), preview and click each design, choose one with 'Build this'
Claude then builds the chosen direction
on_screen_only: GitHub header: 'impeccable' repo, Code / Issues 37 / Pull requests 13, Watch 167, Fork 3.6k, 58.2k stars, 24 branches, Apache License 2.0, link impeccable.style, folder .github updated '4 hours ago'

Browser at 127.0.0.1:37674: 'IMPECCABLE - taketenmin.com - choose the visual world'; subtitle 'The roll assigned The Darkroom. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.'; cards: 'Minishomp Room' ('Your ten minutes as a cozy... pixel room'), 'Take Ten Minutes' (the category standard), 'The Darkroom', 'Phosphor Terminal' ('Ten minutes as a breathing cursor on curved glass'), 'Cloud Quarry'; each with 'Build this'; a status line 'TRUST, OBSERVED.'
Rendered result pages: 'Take Ten Minutes' timer site and a 'STRATOSAFE - BUILD IN BETTER WEATHER' hero with arctic imagery
cta: Comment 'design' to get the GitHub link

relevance.why: Haji builds customer-facing apps; the pick-from-previews flow turns the slowest part of design iteration (describing taste in words) into a 2-minute visual choice, and Impeccable is already endorsed in the liked set.

implement_score.why: Update to Impeccable 4.0 and try Impeccable Live on the next landing page or app shell; ~30 minutes. Risk is that 'worlds' bias toward showy marketing sites rather than utility app UIs.

verify: Confirm Impeccable 4.0 / 'Worlds' and 'Impeccable Live' exist in the pbakaus/impeccable repo and how Live is launched (localhost port 37674 in demo)
Star count: 58.2k on screen vs 'over 50,000' spoken; fine, but check current
Whether the 100+ design systems are licensed for commercial app use and 'rated by a human' means anything measurable

gap.what: Impeccable itself is in the liked set, but the 4.0 'Worlds' competition mechanic (library designs vs Claude's own idea) and the Impeccable Live browser preview/pick loop are new.
